hero.description: I'm a Frontend Developer with a strong foundation in modern web development and a passion for building responsive, user-friendly, and high-performance web applications. I specialize in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, and have hands-on experience developing full-stack applications using Node.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. Through personal projects, including a full-featured e-commerce application and portfolio website, I've implemented authentication, database management, payment integration, email functionality, and responsive UI design. I enjoy solving real-world problems, continuously improving my technical skills, and learning new technologies to write clean, maintainable, and scalable code. My goal is to contribute to a collaborative development team while continuing to grow as a full-stack engineer.

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description:
I've always been interested in technology and wanted to build practical technical skills. That curiosity led me to choose front-end development, where I enjoy creating responsive and user-friendly web applications.

Learning during the AI era has made my journey much more effective. After building a strong foundation in web development, AI became a valuable learning partner, helping me understand new concepts, solve problems, and keep improving whenever I got stuck.

My goal over the next 3-5 years is to work alongside experienced developers, continue growing as a professional, and become an AI-integrated full-stack web developer.
aboutMe.courseDescription: I have a strong foundation in web development, having completed a comprehensive 6-month course that covered HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. This program provided me with the skills and knowledge necessary to build modern, responsive web applications.
